name: Psychology
description: ⚠⚠⚠ The largest undergraduate output of any programme on this site: Florida's public universities awarded 6,228 psychology BACHELOR'S degrees in a single year, and 27 state colleges teach the prefix as well. ⚠⚠ It is an excellent degree and it is not a clinical qualification — every licensed route out of it (counselling, social work, psychology itself) requires a graduate degree the state has far fewer seats for.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THE RATIO IS THE THING NOBODY PUTS IN FRONT OF A FRESHMAN. Florida's public universities award 6,228 psychology bachelor's a year. The graduate routes that lead to a licence award roughly 372 master's between them — 285 counselor education, 57 mental health counseling, 30 marriage and family therapy — plus 1,164 MSW in social work, which is a different licence with its own accredited bachelor's. ⚠ That is about SEVENTEEN psychology graduates for every counselling master's seat. Private institutions add seats and not every psychology graduate wants clinical work, so do not read it as a queue — but read it as the reason to plan the graduate step from your first year rather than your last. ⚠⚠ WHAT THE BACHELOR'S IS ACTUALLY GOOD FOR: it is a strong, widely respected general degree, and this site's own Lawyer and Health Care Administrator pages show psychology graduates reaching both in numbers — 3,850 law applicants and 47,154 medical and health services managers. ⚠⚠⚠ WHAT IT IS NOT: a route to practice. Florida licenses mental health counselors (60-hour CACREP master's plus two supervised years), clinical social workers (CSWE master's plus two years) and psychologists (doctorate, with 48% of the occupation reporting post-doctoral training on top). A psychology bachelor's begins all three and completes none. ⚠ Florida also awards only 232 psychology master's and 82 research doctorates a year across the whole system, so the academic route is narrower still. ⚠⚠ Check the DEPARTMENT before applying to graduate school: most Florida counselling master's degrees sit in colleges of EDUCATION under the counselor education code, not in psychology departments.

cips.note: Psychology, General — 10 Florida public institutions and 6,549 credentials in 2023, of which ⚠ 6,228 are BACHELOR'S degrees, 232 master's and 82 research doctorates. FIU 1,536, UCF 1,509, USF 888, FSU 767, UF 611, FAU 314. ⚠⚠ Undergraduate psychology courses reach far wider than the degree: the PSY prefix is carried by 27 Florida state colleges as well as 11 universities.

related.note: ⚠⚠⚠ The commonest licensed destination, and the ratio is stark: 6,228 psychology bachelor's a year against roughly 372 counselling master's seats at 8 institutions. ⚠ Look in the college of EDUCATION — 285 of those seats are coded counselor education, not psychology or health.

⚠⚠ The other licensed route out, and in several respects the better-resourced one: 1,164 MSW seats a year against counselling's 372. ⚠ But note the trap — a psychology bachelor's is NOT a BSW, earns no advanced standing, and leaves you doing the full 61-hour MSW rather than the 39-hour advanced standing version.

⚠⚠ An underrated destination and a measured one: Census microdata puts PSYCHOLOGY third among the undergraduate fields held by medical and health services managers, at 47,154 people, behind health and business. ⚠ Median $123,860, and no licence required outside nursing homes.

⚠ Named on the evidence rather than by association: LSAC recorded 3,850 psychology applicants to law school, 5.2% of the field. ⚠⚠ And this site's Lawyer page carries the finding that matters — the most law-sounding majors post the lowest mean LSAT, while psychology sits mid-table.

⚠ Behavioural science is one of public health's core disciplines and health behaviour theory comes straight out of psychology. ⚠⚠ The CHES credential is coursework-based rather than major-based, so a psychology graduate who planned the 25 credits deliberately can reach it without a further degree.
